description: Get API Keys - List the workspace's API keys as metadata only: id, label, dates and a masked suffix (e.g. '****1a2b'). Full key values are never returned by any tool. To see or copy a full key, the user opens the API keys page in the SalesBlink app through the magic login link from get_api_key_page_link or get_api_key_refresh_link.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: get_api_keys

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Get API Keys
